_comment: Violence on a town's street map (systems/streetCrime.js, ui/innerMapReactions.js): who sees it, how they react on the spot, what they remember, and what they say afterwards. Vandalism is smashing the town's things (a well, a stall, a lamp, the furniture in someone's house): {victim} is then the thing smashed ('the well'). Placeholders in lines: {victim} the victim's name, {kin} how the speaker names the victim ('my brother Brom', 'Brom'), {player} the player's name, {town} where it happened, {deed} 'killed' / 'beat'.

sight._comment: Chebyshev tiles from the victim. Indoors everyone in the building sees it. Guards within guardHearRadius who did not see it come running all the same; anyone else within hearRadius turns to look, and the timid hurry away.

disposition._comment: Change to a witness's opinion of the player (0-100, 50 neutral). Kin and friends are also hit by NpcDisposition.onNpcHarmed; these are on top.

refuse._comment: A witness below talkBelow will not chat (amends or leave only). Traders who saw it refuse to deal below tradeBelow.

hearsay._comment: Townsfolk who did not see it hear of it through the town's talk: at the scene share = base + perDay * days since (capped at 1); in towns the rumour has reached, elsewhereShare. mentionAgain: chance they bring it up again once already told.

heat._comment: Share of the crime's underworld heat when no one saw it (a body is still found).

arrest._comment: The watch: days in the cell on top of the heat-based sentence, a fine for a beating (scaled by town size, never less than the bounty owed here), the odds of running for it, and how long the guards remember an unanswered crime in their town.

refuseTrade.vandalism: {name} won't trade with someone who goes about smashing the town's things.
refuseTrade.assault: {name} won't trade with someone who beats people in the street.
refuseTrade.murder: {name} saw you kill {victim} and will have nothing to do with you.

lines.refuseTalk: They want nothing to do with you.

text.vandalism: {guard} steps into your path, hand on his sword. "You smashed {victim}, in front of the whole street. Pay for the damage, or see the inside of a cell."
text.assault: {guard} plants himself in your path, hand on his sword. "You beat {victim} in the street, in front of half the town. You can pay the fine, or you can see the inside of a cell."
text.murder: {guard} blocks your way, blade half drawn. "{victim} lies dead and the whole street saw who did it. You're coming with me."

outcomes.submit: You give yourself up. The watch takes you to the cells: {days} days.
outcomes.fine: You count {fine} gold into the guard's hand. He writes it in his book and lets you go, with a warning.
outcomes.escaped: You dodge past {guard} and lose him in the crowd. The watch will be looking for you.
outcomes.caught: You break and run, but {guard} is faster. They drag you to the cells: {days} days.
outcomes.resist: You square up to {guard}. Resisting the watch will not help your name.

found._comment: Coming upon a body (and carriedAlive: seeing the player carry someone senseless — evidence of the beating; blood: a pool of blood whose body is gone — the watch looks into it, systems/carrying.js). radius: how far off a body is noticed (indoors: the whole room). gatherShare of the unafraid walk over to look; the rest stop and stare. Standing within overRadius of a body when it is found, or carrying one, makes the finders witnesses to the killing. barks: kin/friend (grief, {kin} = my wife / my son…, {victim} = name), guard, bystander.fear/anger, caught.{guard,kin,fear,anger}, carried.{guard,fear,anger}.
